children: In week 44, Heimar hf. (“Heimar”) purchased 1,020,000 own shares at a total purchase price of ISK 34,220,000, as follows:

The transactions are in accordance with Heimar’s buyback program, which was announced on August 28, 2026. According to the program, the buybacks will amount to a maximum of ISK 500,000,000 in total, and the program will remain in effect until that limit is reached, but no later than the end of 2026.

Heimar owned 37,410,000 shares prior to the above transactions, and following these purchases the Company now holds 38,430,000 shares, or approximately 1.95% of the company’s issued shares, with a total purchase price of ISK 1,356,802,660 for the year 2026.

The execution of the buyback program will comply with the Icelandic Public Limited Companies Act, No. 2/1995, Article 5 of the European Parliament and Council Regulation (EU) No. 596/2014 on Market Abuse, as referred to in the Icelandic Act on Measures Against Market Abuse, No. 60/2021, as well as the European Commission's delegated Regulation No. 2016/1052/EU, which contains technical standards regarding buyback programs.
In case of any discrepancy between the English and Icelandic versions of this notice, the Icelandic version shall prevail.
Björn Eyþór Benediktsson – Chief Financial Officer – eythor@heimar.is
